title: AI Specialist
description:
**AI Specialist**

**Company:** Digital Jockey  
**Location:** Habsiguda, Hyderabad, Telangana – In-Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Department:** AI & Technology

**About Digital Jockey**

Digital Jockey is a performance-driven digital marketing company combining **AI automation with human expertise** to build scalable marketing systems for businesses.

We are looking for an **AI Specialist** who can go beyond using AI tools — someone who can **understand code, build AI-powered tools, develop AI agents, work with cloud infrastructure, and turn business requirements into working AI solutions.**

**Job Overview**

As an **AI Specialist**, you will be responsible for researching, developing, testing, and deploying AI-powered tools and automation systems for Digital Jockey and its clients.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across **AI, coding, cloud platforms, VPS servers, SSH, APIs, automation, AI agents, and rapid/vibe coding workflows.**

You should be able to take an idea such as:

**“We need an AI tool that can automate this business process.”**

and turn it into a **functional AI-powered solution.**

**Key Responsibilities1. AI Tool Development**

* Research and evaluate new AI technologies, models, platforms, and APIs.
* Build custom AI-powered tools for internal and client requirements.
* Integrate AI models into websites, applications, dashboards, and business workflows.
* Develop AI solutions using APIs from leading AI platforms.
* Create AI-powered content, automation, lead-generation, analysis, and productivity tools.
* Test and improve AI tools for accuracy, reliability, speed, and scalability.

**2. AI Agent Development**

* Build and deploy **AI Agents** capable of performing multi-step tasks.
* Create agent workflows using APIs, tools, databases, and external services.
* Develop AI systems that can research, analyze, communicate, automate tasks, and take predefined actions.
* Connect AI agents with CRM systems, websites, marketing platforms, databases, and business applications.
* Continuously improve agent performance and reliability.

**3. Coding & Vibe Coding**

* Write, understand, debug, modify, and maintain code.
* Use **AI-assisted/Vibe Coding workflows** to rapidly prototype and develop applications.
* Convert business ideas and prompts into functional software.
* Work with AI coding assistants to accelerate development while maintaining code quality.
* Understand existing codebases and make required modifications without breaking functionality.
* Troubleshoot bugs, API errors, authentication issues, and integration problems.

**4. Cloud, VPS & Server Management**

* Deploy AI tools and applications on **VPS/cloud servers**.
* Work with Linux-based environments.
* Use **SSH** for remote server access and management.
* Configure applications, environments, domains, ports, databases, and services.
* Install and manage required packages, dependencies, and runtime environments.
* Monitor applications and troubleshoot server-related issues.
* Understand basic server security, backups, permissions, and deployment practices.

**5. API & Automation**

* Work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and third-party integrations.
* Connect AI tools with platforms such as CRM, Google, Meta, websites, databases, and other business applications.
* Build automated workflows that reduce repetitive manual work.
* Develop systems for data collection, processing, analysis, and reporting.
* Create integrations between multiple software platforms.

**6. Automotive AI Solutions**

Digital Jockey works extensively with the **automotive industry**, so the candidate should be interested in building AI solutions for automotive dealerships and automotive marketing.

Responsibilities may include:

* Developing AI tools for automotive dealerships.
* Building AI-powered vehicle inventory solutions.
* Automating vehicle listing creation and publishing.
* Developing AI-generated vehicle descriptions, advertisements, and marketing content.
* Creating AI solutions for lead management and lead qualification.
* Building AI-powered follow-up and communication systems.
* Working with vehicle inventory feeds and automotive data.
* Creating AI systems for dealership marketing automation.
* Exploring AI solutions for Google Ads, Meta Ads, Marketplace, CRM, and automotive websites.
* Developing tools that help dealerships manage thousands of vehicles and marketing activities efficiently.

**Required Technical SkillsAI & Development**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI and LLMs.
* Experience working with AI APIs.
* Understanding of AI Agents and agent workflows.
* Ability to write and understand code.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with AI-assisted coding / Vibe Coding.

**Programming**

Knowledge of one or more:

* Python
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Node.js
* HTML/CSS
* REST APIs
* JSON
* SQL

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Linux basics.
* VPS management.
* SSH.
* Domain and DNS basics.
* Application deployment.
* Environment variables.
* Server permissions.
* Basic networking concepts.
* Git/GitHub.

**Automation & Integrations**

* API integrations.
* Webhooks.
* OAuth/API authentication.
* Database integrations.
* Workflow automation.
* CRM integrations.

**Good to Have**

Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:

* OpenAI APIs
* Gemini APIs
* Claude APIs
* AI Agent frameworks
* n8n
* LangChain / LangGraph
* MCP
* Docker
* GitHub
* Supabase
* PostgreSQL
* Firebase
* AWS / Azure / Google Cloud
* Cloudflare
* WordPress APIs
* Google APIs
* Meta APIs
* CRM APIs
* Automotive inventory APIs / feeds
* Google Ads API
* Meta Marketing API

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* **Thinks like a builder, not just an AI tool user.**
* Can understand how software works.
* Can read and modify existing code.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Is comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and technologies.
* Can troubleshoot problems independently.
* Can work with AI coding assistants effectively.
* Can take an idea from **concept → prototype → development → deployment.**
* Is interested in building practical AI solutions for real businesses.
* Has a strong interest in **AI + Automation + Marketing + Automotive Technology.**

**Example Projects You May Work On**

You may work on projects such as:

* AI-powered marketing tools
* AI content generation systems
* AI lead-management systems
* AI chatbots
* AI agents
* Automated CRM workflows
* AI-powered reporting dashboards
* Automotive inventory automation
* AI vehicle listing generators
* AI dealership marketing tools
* AI-powered Marketplace automation
* Lead qualification agents
* AI customer follow-up systems
* Internal Digital Jockey automation tools
* Custom AI SaaS-style applications

**Qualification**

**Education:**Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

However, **strong practical skills and demonstrated AI/software projects are more important than a degree.**

**Experience**

**1–3 years** of experience in software development, AI development, automation, or a related technical role.

Freshers with strong hands-on AI development projects, coding skills, and a demonstrable portfolio may also be considered.

**How We Evaluate Candidates**

Candidates may be asked to demonstrate their ability to:

* Understand an existing codebase.
* Build a small AI-powered tool.
* Connect an AI API to an application.
* Create a basic AI Agent.
* Deploy an application on a VPS.
* Connect to a server using SSH.
* Debug an existing application.
* Explain how their AI solution works.
* Build a small automation based on a real business requirement.

**What You Will Get**

* Opportunity to work on **real-world AI projects**.
* Exposure to Generative AI and AI Agents.
* Hands-on experience with cloud and VPS infrastructure.
* Opportunity to build AI tools from scratch.
* Exposure to **AI + Digital Marketing + Automotive Technology**.
* Opportunity to experiment with emerging AI technologies.
* Work on projects that are deployed and used by real businesses.
* Fast-paced environment focused on learning, experimentation, and execution.

**Core Skills**

**AI | Generative AI | AI Agents | Python | JavaScript | APIs | Automation | Vibe Coding | VPS | Linux | SSH | Cloud | Git | Databases | Webhooks | AI Tools | Automotive AI**

**Apply**

Interested candidates should share their **Resume/CV and portfolio/GitHub links**, along with examples of AI tools, applications, automations, or AI Agents they have built.

**Digital Jockey***AI to Scale. People for Precision.*

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: Principal Engineer - MCP or ACP Layer (API & AI Orchestration)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

  

ABC Fitness is building an intelligent platform for the fitness industry, with AI embedded into the products, workflows, and decision points our customers rely on every day. Our strategy is focused on using AI to automate routine work, personalize experiences, surface actionable insights, and help operators move from reactive management to proactive, data-informed execution. We are investing in the platform, data, and product capabilities required to deliver secure, scalable AI experiences that improve efficiency, strengthen engagement, and drive better business outcomes.  
  
As a Principal AI Engineer, you will serve as a senior individual contributor and technical leader responsible for building the MCP / ACP connectivity layer that enables AI agents to safely and reliably interact with ABC’s business systems. This layer acts as the translation and orchestration plane between core APIs and autonomous agents, transforming complex business logic into structured, agent-consumable tools.  
  
You will architect and build the platform services, orchestration patterns, schemas, and control mechanisms that enable scalable AI execution across ABC Fitness. This is a highly hands-on platform engineering role for someone who combines deep distributed systems expertise with practical experience designing reliable AI orchestration and agent execution systems in production.

We’re looking for a senior individual contributor who can independently lead delivery of an LLM feature area, including eval strategy and production readiness.  
  
**All applicants must be able to work from our Hyderabad office 2-3x a week**  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Architect, build, and evolve the MCP / ACP ecosystem that exposes ABC Fitness capabilities as standardized, agent-consumable tools.
* Design schemas, tool definitions, and abstraction layers that shield AI agents from the complexity and inconsistency of underlying systems while providing clean, structured, hallucination-resistant interfaces.
* Define and implement reusable orchestration patterns for multi-step AI workflows, including tool use, validation, retries, state management, fallback handling, and long-running execution flows.
* Build for deterministic execution by ensuring AI-driven tool interactions are predictable, safe, observable, auditable, and reversible where necessary.
* Establish company-wide standards for AI interaction patterns, structured outputs, input/output validation, schema governance, and agent orchestration workflows.
* Design and implement security, permissions, and access control patterns specifically for non-human actors and autonomous systems, including auditability, rate controls, and operational boundaries.
* Build instrumentation and observability capabilities that trace agent interactions, identify schema friction, measure execution quality, and improve orchestration success rates over time.
* Partner closely with API modernization, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to define AI-ready integration patterns and ensure scalable production operations.
* Lead technical design reviews and influence architecture decisions across teams building AI-native systems on the platform.
* Define and document reusable patterns, reference implementations, SDKs, and paved paths that accelerate safe AI adoption across ABC Fitness.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including deep expertise building distributed backend systems, APIs, orchestration layers, or platform infrastructure; experience in the broader 8–14 year principal range is most aligned for this level.
* Proven experience designing and operating high-scale backend systems with strong understanding of state management, concurrency, reliability, and distributed execution patterns.
* Strong understanding of how LLMs interact with tools and workflows, including schema design, structured outputs, predictable execution patterns, and orchestration reliability.
* Deep expertise in abstraction design and wrapping legacy or complex systems with clean, scalable, and reusable interfaces.
* Experience building workflow orchestration systems handling retries, failure states, long-running processes, and multi-step execution logic.
* Demonstrated ability to define technical standards and influence engineering direction across multiple teams through architecture, design review, and strong engineering judgment.
* Strong production mindset, including experience designing for observability, operational resilience, auditability, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Product, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams.
* A growth mindset and strong learning agility in a rapidly evolving AI and platform engineering landscape.
* A One Team orientation: able to enable other engineering teams, establish scalable paved paths, and create reusable platform capabilities rather than isolated solutions.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE**

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), ACP patterns, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with middleware platforms, API gateways, service mesh architectures, or distributed control planes.
* Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or shared engineering tooling.
* Experience implementing AI observability, tracing, prompt tracking, model evaluation, or orchestration telemetry systems.
* Familiarity with policy enforcement, safe model execution, permissioning systems, and AI governance patterns in production environments.
* Experience helping engineering organizations adopt new technical standards through documentation, mentoring, and reference implementations.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The MCP / ACP layer becomes the standardized paved path for how AI agents interact with ABC business systems.
* Product and platform teams can integrate new AI agents and workflows with core systems quickly, safely, and consistently.
* AI workflows are reliable, observable, auditable, and secure in production environments.
* Agent actions are fully permissioned, rate-limited, and operationally controlled to prevent unsafe or unintended behavior.
* Platform standards reduce integration complexity and accelerate adoption of AI-native development patterns across engineering teams.
* The connectivity layer directly enables new AI-powered product capabilities, intelligent services, and operational automation initiatives.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

description:

Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long-standing presence in technology. Our teams are certified in revenue cycle best practices and are supporting end-to-end RCM operations. We are at the forefront of innovation using cutting-edge technology to drive meaningful impact in the Revenue Cycle Management landscape. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.

**The Opportunity:**

**Job Title: Senior Engineer,Cybersecurity**

**Experience: 7+ Years**

**Job Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid)**

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer to join our Security Engineering team. This role is responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing the enterprise security technology stack - spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and data security platforms. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of progressive cybersecurity engineering experience and deep technical knowledge across a broad range of modern security platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role offering a growth path toward Senior Cybersecurity Engineer or Lead Cybersecurity Engineer.

Key Responsibilities

Design, deploy, configure, and maintain security platforms across Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Identity and Access Management (IAM), the Microsoft Defender stack, network security, and application security tooling.

Deploy and manage Network Detection and Response (NDR), SIEM logging/monitoring, and User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) solutions to strengthen enterprise-wide threat visibility.

Build, maintain, and optimize security automation and orchestration (SOAR) playbooks to streamline detection, response, and operational workflows.

Manage security agent deployment, health, and lifecycle across endpoints (EDR, logging, and monitoring agents).

Partner with and oversee Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) relationships, serving as the internal technical escalation point and ensuring SLA and detection quality standards are met.

Own and mature the vulnerability management program, including scanning, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.

Implement and manage Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), and AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) tool to identify and remediate misconfigurations and emerging risk across cloud and AI environments.

Administer and optimize the Microsoft Defender suite (Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365, and Defender for Cloud).

Support IAM engineering initiatives, including identity lifecycle management, conditional access, privileged access management (PAM), and single sign-on (SSO).

Contribute to security design reviews and help define technical standards for new projects and initiatives.

Support incident response and threat hunting activities, leveraging SIEM, NDR, and UEBA telemetry to investigate and contain threats.

Collaborate cross-functionally with network, cloud, application, and infrastructure teams to embed security into the broader technology environment.

Maintain accurate network and system diagrams, runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and change documentation.

Participate in an On-Call rotation to support critical security incidents outside of business hours.

Mentor junior security engineers and share knowledge across the team.

Required Qualifications:

7+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering or a related technical security role.

Hands-on experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and endpoint agent management.

Hands-on experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms and identity security concepts.

Working experience with the Microsoft Defender stack (Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365, and/or Defender for Cloud).

Experience with network security management and application security/management practices.

Experience with Network Detection and Response (NDR) and UEBA solutions for threat and anomaly detection.

Experience with SIEM platforms for logging, monitoring, detection engineering, and alert tuning.

Experience with security automation/orchestration (SOAR) tooling.

Experience working with or managing a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP).

Experience with vulnerability management programs and remediation processes.

Experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM); exposure to AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) is a strong plus.

Strong understanding of networking, cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS), and identity protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC).

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across multiple security domains simultaneously.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical decisions and risk trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively across engineering and security operations teams.

Required Certifications:

Candidates should hold, or be actively working toward, a combination of the following:

CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)

CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

CompTIA Security+

SC-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst)

SC-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator)

AZ-500 (Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate)

AWS Certified Security - Specialty (or equivalent AWS security certification)

Preferred Certifications (Plus):

PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer)

CCFA (CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Experience:

Endpoint management experience (e.g., Microsoft Intune, SCCM) is a plus.

Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, Zero Trust).

Experience integrating security tooling into DevSecOps / CI-CD pipelines.

Experience working in a healthcare organization or other highly regulated industry, with familiarity with HIPAA and PHI-handling requirements.

Prior experience with change management/ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira).

People First, Last + Always

**A Place to Thrive**

Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.

ABOUT AMGEN


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

  

  

ABOUT THE ROLE


ROLE DESCRIPTION:


Amgen is hiring a hands\-on Machine Learning Engineer (Level 4\) to design, build and operationalize generative and agentic AI systems that are safe, auditable and production ready. You will own LLM and agent capabilities, evaluation frameworks and guardrails, and work with data science, product, platform and compliance partners to move models from prototype into trusted enterprise services.

  

  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  

  

* Design, implement and deploy LLM solutions and agent frameworks for production workflows, focusing on reliability, interpretability and safety.


* Build and run evaluation pipelines: automated metrics, unit and integration test suites, adversarial/red\-team tests, and human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation.


* Create and operationalize guardrails: prompt patterns, policy enforcement, input sanitization, output validation, data filtering and explainability tools.


* Prototype and productionize agentic behaviours: RAGs, multi\-step planners, tool\-use interfaces, state management and safe action execution.


* Implement MLOps best practices: model versioning, CI/CD for models, scalable serving, observability and cost controls.


* Partner with security, privacy, regulatory and ethics teams to embed compliance and auditability into deployments.


* Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements

  

  

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS:


* 5 to 9 years of applied machine learning or software engineering experience, including at least 2 years on production ML systems.


* B.Tech, M.Tech or MS with specialization in Computer Science.

Job Description
  
  

R419034 Manager, Data Stewardship
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  

Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

The Manager, SCM Data Stewardship plays a key role in the creation, maintenance, accuracy, and compliant execution of master data supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management operations. The role combines hands\-on master data stewardship responsibilities with the leadership and development of a small team of approximately 3–8 Data Stewards.
  
Reporting directly to the Global Lead for Data Stewardship for Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management, the Manager supports day\-to\-day master data execution while ensuring team priorities remain aligned with global standards, business requirements, and strategic objectives.
  
  

What will you do in this role

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 3–8 Data Stewards while remaining actively involved in operational master data activities.
* Manage team workload, priorities, and delivery.
* Conduct performance reviews, goal\-setting, feedback, and talent\-development conversations.
* Support onboarding, capability building, knowledge transfer, and individual development.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high\-performing team environment.


Stakeholder and Priority Management

* Collaborate with business and cross\-functional stakeholders to resolve issues and dependencies.


Automation and Continuous Improvement

* Proactively identify recurring manual activities that could be improved through automation or new technology.
* Support the adoption and effective use of new digital and AI\-enabled tools within Data Stewardship.
* Apply tools such as Gemini to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, problem solving, and ways of working.
* Contribute operational expertise to the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new Master Data Management technologies and capabilities.


What should you have
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant experience in master data management, data stewardship, SAP master data, Supply Chain Management, or related operational roles.
* Previous experience leading or managing a small team.


Primary skills (must\-have)
  
  

* Strong practical knowledge of SAP master data processes, preferably SAP ECC and SAP S/4\.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Material Master Data creation, maintenance, extension, and change activities.
* Good understanding of Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management processes.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in operational execution.
* Highly organized, with the ability to balance personal operational responsibilities and team priorities.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong people\-management, coaching, and development skills.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong familiarity with Gemini and the ability to use generative AI effectively in day\-to\-day work.
* Strong interest in automation, digital tools, and new technologies and the ability to identify practical opportunities for their application.
* Good understanding of GxP principles and controlled working practices.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.


Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Experience within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with SAP S/4 transformation or migration activities.

* Experience supporting automation, workflow, or process\-improvement initiatives.

title: Associate Director , Data Stewardship
description:
Job Description
  
  

R419321 Associate. Director , Data Stewardship
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  

Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.The Associate Director, Technical Product Owner – Automation Material Master Stewardship is a high\-impact, hybrid leadership role. It requires a rare blend of deep Material Master Data domain expertise and advanced technical product management capabilities.
  
  

Operating at the intersection of supply chain operations, enterprise IT, and digital innovation, this individual will own the technical roadmap for our core data creation and maintenance platforms (specifically Syniti / DSP and its complex integrations into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
  

**The roles mission is twofold:**  

* Material Master Domain Leadership Tool Ownership: Act as the technical and operational authority for the global Material Master data model in our stewardship tools. You will ensure these systems operate with high reliability, comply with rigid data standards, and evolve through structured releases to support complex supply chain and manufacturing activities.
* Process Automation Workflow Re\-engineering: Partner with Global Data Steward Leads, Quality, and IT teams to systematically transition stewardship activities from manual, high\-touch execution to intelligent, streamlined, and automated workflows.


As a senior technical leader within the Hyderabad Tech Center, you will leverage local technical talent while maintaining global alignment to drive operational excellence, GxP compliance, and modern automation practices (including generative AI and workflow orchestration).
  
  

What Will You Do in This Role
  
  

1\. Material Master Data Domain Governance Platform Ownership
  
  

**Govern the Material Master Data Model:** Serve as the technical custodian for the Material Master data structure within our stewardship tools, ensuring a deep understanding of master data dependencies, taxonomy, and downstream impacts on manufacturing and logistics.
  
**Own the Tooling Ecosystem:** Act as the Technical Product Owner for data creation, change management, and validation tooling (such as Syniti/DSP and associated middleware connecting into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
**Align Business Logic with Tech:** Translate complex Material Master requirements (e.g., global vs. local views, Plant/Storage Location parameters, Bill of Materials (BOM) configurations, and regulatory metadata) into precise technical specifications and tool rules.
  
**Backlog Release Management:** Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, feature prioritization, and release roadmaps in close coordination with IT delivery engineers, architecture teams, and global business stewards.
  
  

2\. Process Re\-Engineering, Simplification Automation
  
  

**End\-to\-End Material Workflow Optimization:** Deep\-dive into existing material stewardship processes (such as first\-time material code creation, changes, and plant extensions) to eliminate manual bottlenecks, redundant pre\-checks, and handoff delays.
  
**Intelligent Automation Delivery:** Design, evaluate, and implement automation solutions across the material lifecycle, utilizing business rule engines, automated validation scripts, API integrations, and low\-code orchestration platforms.
  
**AI GenAI Integration:** Spearhead the practical adoption of generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and machine learning capabilities to assist data stewards in automated data validation, material request interpretation, anomaly detection, and auto\-generated documentation.
  
**Industry Best Practices:** Benchmark external master data management (MDM) and supply chain automation frameworks to keep our operating model forward\-looking and scalable.
  
  

3\. Quality, GxP Compliance Data Integrity
  
  

**Quality Validation Partnership:** Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), and Regulatory teams to ensure all tooling enhancements, automation bots, and scripts meet strict GxP and audit standards.
  
**Automated Data Quality Controls:** Build automated, GxP\-compliant data governance pre\-checks, validation rules, and mandatory approval workflows directly into the tooling UI to enforce data integrity at the moment of entry.
  
**Audit Readiness Traceability:** Ensure full lifecycle traceability, change control documentation, and audit trail reliability for all automated and system\-assisted data operations.
  
  

4\. Global Partnership, Location Synergy Team Upskilling
  
  

**Bridge IT and Stewardship Operations:** Serve as the primary technical liaison in Hyderabad, connecting local IT/software product development with global data stewardship leaders and supply chain operations.
  
**Drive Change Adoption:** Partner with Global Data Leads and operational managers to design rollout plans, training materials, and change\-management programs for new automated ways of working.
  
**Technical Mentorship:** Foster an automation\-first culture across the Hyderabad stewardship hub, coaching team members on digital tools, prompt engineering, and automated testing practices.
  
  

What Should You Have
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Data Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).


**Experience:**  

* 8 years of progressive experience in Master Data Management (MDM), Technical Product Ownership, Business Systems Analysis, or Enterprise Data Solutions.
* Strong functional background in SAP Material Master (MM) operations, with a clear understanding of supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing data flows.
* Substantial experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment (pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or medical devices preferred).
* Proven track record of owning enterprise tooling releases and delivering measurable automation or process simplification projects.


Primary Skills (Must\-Have)
  
  

* Deep Material Master Data Expertise: Comprehensive, practical knowledge of the SAP Material Master data structure, fields, views (Basic, Sales, Purchasing, MRP, Plant/Storage, Costing), and how data setups impact downstream physical supply chain execution.
* Tool Ownership MDM Platforms: Hands\-on technical experience with master data creation and governance platforms, preferably Syniti (DSP) or comparable enterprise MDM/governance suites.
* SAP Master Data Architecture: Solid technical and functional knowledge of SAP master data processes (SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA), specifically Material Master and its integration with manufacturing, procurement, and supply chain modules.
* Process Automation Digitization: Demonstrated success identifying, designing, and rolling out workflow automation, rule engines, RPA, or automated data validation pipelines.
* Modern AI GenAI Fluency: Practical experience leveraging Generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and digital productivity tools to accelerate data operations, validation logic, and process documentation.
* Agile Product Ownership: Expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies, writing technical user stories, managing sprint roadmaps, and running User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* GxP Regulated Environment Compliance: Strong understanding of GxP standards, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), data integrity requirements, and regulated change control procedures.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge complex business requirements with technical IT engineering across global time zones.


**Who we are:**  

We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  

**What we look for:**  

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.  

We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:  

Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign\-off.  

Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.  

Test operator\-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.  

Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.  

Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.  

You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.  

  

A day in the life  

You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign\-off is the gate.  

  

About the team  

Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4\+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience in penetration testing and exploitability\-focused vulnerability assessment
* Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
* Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Analyst/ Sr. Analyst
description:
**Position: Analyst or Senior Analyst**


**Team: Healthcare**


**Location: Hyderabad**


About Us:


**GlobalData is a productivity and intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.**

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose\-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organizations see what's coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.


Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organizations across the world's largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.


**THE OPPORTUNITY**


Drug innovation is increasingly driven by advanced modalities such as ADC, cell and gene therapies, bispecific antibodies and RNA\-based therapies. Understanding how these therapies are designed, and how they differ from one another, is essential for the pharmaceutical, biotech and investment clients we serve.


GlobalData Healthcare – Pharma is expanding its coverage of drug modalities and is looking for **Analysts and Senior Analysts in Hyderabad** to join the team. You will research the science behind these therapies, capture detailed technical information, and help ensure that drugs are classified accurately and consistently across our databases.


This role suits researchers who combine depth in one or more advanced modalities with a structured, detail\-driven approach, and who want to apply their expertise to high\-quality drug intelligence used by clients worldwide.


What we are looking for:


**Education**


* M. Pharm or M.S. (Pharm) in Pharmacology, Biotechnology or a related specialisation
* M.Sc. or M. Tech in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Immunology, Genetics, Microbiology or a related life\-science discipline.
* A PhD in a relevant field (e.g., immunology, cell and gene therapy, nucleic acid chemistry, antibody engineering).


**Experience**


* 2–5 years of relevant experience in pharma or biotech R\&D, academic research, CROs, pharmaceutical intelligence or scientific data curation. Candidates with a PhD and 2\+ years of industry or postdoctoral experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Hands\-on laboratory or research experience in at least one advanced modality, such as cell therapy, gene therapy or gene editing, ADCs, nucleic acid therapies or antibody engineering, is strongly preferred. Experience in cell\-based therapies is particularly valued.
* Experience with taxonomy or ontology development, biomedical data curation or scientific classification is highly desirable.


**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS**


**Scientific knowledge**


* In\-depth understanding of the science behind at least one advanced modality, and working knowledge of others.
* Strong foundation in molecular biology, immunology and pharmacology, including targets and mechanisms of action.
* Good understanding of the drug development lifecycle, from discovery to post\-marketing.
* Familiarity with drug naming conventions, including WHO INN nomenclature for biologics and cell and gene therapies.


**Taxonomy and data skills**


* Structured thinking: the ability to break complex science into discrete, well\-defined and mutually exclusive attributes.
* Understanding of taxonomy principles such as hierarchies, controlled vocabularies and synonym management. Familiarity with MeSH, NCI Thesaurus, Gene Ontology or ChEBI is an advantage.
* Advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, data validation). Basic SQL or scripting knowledge is an advantage.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted research tools responsibly, with careful verification of their output.


**Research and communication**


* Strong, systematic secondary research skills across PubMed, Clinical Trial Registries, patent databases, regulatory sources, conference abstracts and presentation, etc.
* Strong attention to detail and critical thinking, with the ability to identify incorrect, incomplete or conflicting information.
* Clear written English, including the ability to document definitions, rules and decision rationale.
* Ability to work independently and in a global team, manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.


Key Responsibilities:


**Modality research and data capture**


* Conduct in\-depth secondary research on drugs across modalities and development stages, from discovery and preclinical work through clinical development and approval.
* Extract detailed technical attributes for each drug, such as construct design, delivery system, chemistry and engineering features, from scientific publications, conference abstracts and posters, patents, clinical trial registries, regulatory documents and company disclosures.
* Interpret complex, incomplete or ambiguous technical information and decide what can be captured reliably, with clear source references.
* Track new drugs, pipeline events and emerging technologies within assigned modalities.


**Taxonomy development and classification**


* Contribute to the design and development of modality taxonomies, including hierarchical categories, attribute fields, controlled vocabularies and permitted values.
* Write clear definitions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and classification rules for each category and attribute.
* Build and maintain synonyms and naming conventions so that drugs are mapped consistently and can be found easily through search and filters.
* Classify and map drugs to the taxonomy, applying the rules consistently across records.
* Document curation guidelines, decision logs and worked examples to support consistent classification across the team.


**Data quality and database management**


* Create, review and update drug records in GlobalData databases, identifying missing, outdated or inconsistent information.
* Cross\-check information across multiple sources and perform quality checks on research and database outputs.
* Flag data\-quality issues and work with the relevant team members to resolve them.


**Collaboration and delivery**


* Work with fellow analysts, subject matter experts and Managers to resolve scientific and classification questions.
* Work with product, data and technology teams to translate the taxonomy into database structures and search features.
* Share modality knowledge with the wider team and support quality improvement initiatives.
* Manage assigned work and deliver within agreed timelines, collaborating with global teams across time zones.

You will partner with business stakeholders, technical SMEs, and delivery teams to define product vision, prioritize the backlog, and guide delivery of technical solutions. Modeling \& Implementation:

Collaborate cross\-functionally to integrate AI agents into enterprise platforms via APIs, SDKs, and microservices.  
* 

Technical Leadership \& Innovation:


* Stay updated with state\-of\-the\-art technologies (LLMs, reinforcement learning, multi\-agent systems) and introduce best practices into solutions.
* Mentor engineers and data scientists in architectural patterns, agentic solution design, and deployable AI workflows.
  

Lead pilot Proof\-of\-Concepts (PoCs) to validate feasibility and scale high\-impact AI systems.

Governance, Ethics \& Performance:


* Establish AI governance standards, security baselines, and compliance mechanisms to address reliability and ethical considerations in agentic systems.

Define performance monitoring, lifecycle metrics, and validation approaches for production AI agents.  
* 

Stakeholder Engagement:


* Partner with product owners, clients, and engineering stakeholders to translate business challenges into technical architectures.
* Present architectural frameworks, solution roadmaps, and AI strategies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


#### **Required Skills \& Qualifications:**


Educational Background:


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field.

Ph.D. in relevant domain is a strong plus.

* Strong communication skills with ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical \& business stakeholders.

===============

**Role Summary**


The Director, AI Security will build and lead an India\-based AI security engineering and enablement function responsible for protecting enterprise use of artificial intelligence: generative AI, copilots, agents, large language models, machine learning platforms, AI\-enabled SaaS, and AI\-integrated business workflows.


Reporting to the U.S.\-based Senior Director, Data \& AI Security, with a dotted line to the India\-based Senior Director, Endpoint \& Infrastructure Security, this role translates global AI security strategy into scalable engineering, control, and governance outcomes. It is both strategic and technical, and focused on securing AI adoption without blocking innovation while addressing data leakage, prompt injection, model misuse, insecure integrations, shadow AI, agentic workflow risk, and intellectual property exposure.


The role establishes India as a strategic global center of excellence for AI security engineering and operations, not only a delivery location.


**Key Responsibilities**


**AI Security Strategy and Execution**


Translate enterprise Data \& AI Security strategy into India\-based delivery plans, engineering roadmaps, and measurable objectives.


Lead design and execution of security controls across internally developed models, third\-party AI services, SaaS AI features, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled automation.


Establish practical AI security patterns that enable innovation while protecting sensitive data, regulated information, credentials, and IP.

  

  

**AI Security Architecture and Engineering**


Lead AI security architecture across enterprise AI platforms, cloud AI services, model integrations, data pipelines, and AI\-enabled applications.


Create and maintain secure design patterns for generative AI platforms, LLM and model API integrations, RAG systems, vector databases and embeddings, AI agents and tool invocation, prompt and response handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.


Ensure designs address confidentiality, integrity, availability, identity, data protection, privacy, auditability, resilience, and abuse prevention.

  

  

**AI Risk Management and Control Design**


Define and operationalize controls for prompt injection (direct and indirect), sensitive data leakage, model manipulation and abuse, insecure plugin/tool/agent integrations, unauthorized access through RAG or connectors, excessive agency and unsafe automation, shadow AI, insecure model supply chain, and IP exposure.


Partner with risk, legal, privacy, and compliance to ensure AI controls are practical, enforceable, and measurable.


Partner with Data Security and Privacy on classification, minimization, residency, DLP, encryption and key management, entitlement review, retention, and training and RAG corpus governance — ensuring AI does not create uncontrolled copies, embeddings, or derived data stores outside enterprise governance.

  

  

**Cross\-Domain Control Integration**


Work with the India\-based Senior Director, Endpoint \& Infrastructure Security to embed AI security requirements into endpoint, browser, infrastructure, collaboration, developer, and platform controls.


Drive integration across secure access to AI tools from managed and unmanaged endpoints, endpoint DLP, device posture and conditional access, developer workstation protections for AI\-assisted coding, secrets protection, secure hosting of AI workloads, and AI telemetry.

  

  

**Secure AI Adoption, Assurance, and Operations**


Build practical enablement: AI security intake, risk tiering, assessment templates, control requirements, approved\-tool guardrails, shadow AI discovery, production readiness checklists, and exception models.


Lead or enable AI security testing for prompt injection, RAG data leakage, authorization bypass, connector misuse, unsafe agent actions, excessive permissions, adversarial input, and AI\-generated code risk — in partnership with application security, red team, and model risk.


Partner with cyber defense and the SOC to define AI telemetry, monitoring, and incident response playbooks covering AI tool usage, high\-risk prompt and response patterns, sensitive data movement, connector and agent activity, and shadow AI indicators.

  

  

**Team Leadership and India Capability Building**


Build and lead an India\-based AI security team spanning architecture, engineering, assurance, governance enablement, and technical program management.


Develop a leadership bench and technical career path across AI security architecture, cloud and platform security, application and API security, AI security testing, and automation.

  

  

**Required Experience**


12\+ years in cybersecurity, application security, data security, cloud or infrastructure security, AI/ML security, or related technology risk disciplines.


5\+ years leading technical cybersecurity or security engineering teams.


Strong understanding of generative AI, machine learning platforms, AI\-enabled SaaS, APIs, data pipelines, cloud platforms, and enterprise application architectures.


Experience defining security controls for high\-risk or emerging technology platforms.


Strong understanding of data protection, identity, endpoint, cloud, application, infrastructure, and cyber defense dependencies.


Demonstrated ability to translate emerging technology risk into practical architecture, engineering, and control outcomes.


Ability to lead across geographies, cultures, and time zones, with strong executive\-level written and verbal communication.

  

  

**Preferred Experience**


Securing enterprise AI, generative AI, LLM, or AI\-enabled SaaS platforms, including RAG, vector databases, AI agents, copilots, model APIs, AI gateways, or prompt security controls.


Healthcare, pharmaceutical services, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.


AI governance frameworks, model risk management, privacy engineering, or responsible AI programs.


OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or HITRUST.


Cloud AI services across Azure, AWS, or GCP.


Building a new security capability or establishing India\-based global security capabilities.

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

As we work to develop treatments that look after others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

title: Machine Learning Engineer II, Hyderabad
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Machine Learning Engineer II, Hyderabad**

 **About Warner Bros. Discovery:**


Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.


For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.

 **Meet our Team**


Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) brings together iconic entertainment, news, and sports brands including HBO Max, CNN, Discovery\+, DC, Warner Bros., Bleacher Report, and Food Network. Within the SPARK organization, our Hyderabad Machine Learning Engineering team turns first\-party audience signals into ML capabilities for identity, audience intelligence, advertising, personalization, forecasting, engagement, and retention.


At WBD, MLEs do rigorous data science *and* own the engineering that brings models to life: production ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and the ML infrastructure — feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps — that make our work reliable, repeatable, and scalable. We build primarily on **Databricks**, with strong working knowledge of **Snowflake** and **AWS**, and we are an early, enthusiastic adopter of agentic AI development workflows.

**About the Role**


As a Machine Learning Engineer II on the Hyderabad SPARK team, you will be a hands\-on builder of production ML systems across WBD’s consumer platforms. You will translate data science ideas into reliable pipelines, models, and services that support identity, audience intelligence, advertising, personalization, forecasting, engagement, and retention use cases.


You will work closely with senior engineers, data scientists, product managers, and platform teams to build reproducible ML workflows, improve model quality, and help operate models with strong monitoring, governance, and production\-readiness practices.

 **What You’ll Do** :

 **Technical Execution \& Delivery**

* Build and operate low\-latency online serving systems for fraud scoring, message decisioning, and real\-time personalization.
* Develop ML models for identity resolution, audience intelligence, content\-affinity modeling, genre\-preference modeling, and time\-series forecasting across global markets.
* Integrate with personalization and activation systems to consume in\-app user signals and deliver model outputs into downstream workflows.
* Implement feature pipelines that combine real\-time streaming signals with batch\-computed features for online scoring.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to translate business problems into well\-scoped ML solutions.
* Contributes to evaluations of new technologies and approaches, including DCR\-native modeling, graph ML, agentic ML orchestration, and LLM\-augmented pipelines.

**Production ML Systems**

* Build and improve **probabilistic identity resolution** components that connect unauthenticated device IDs and first\-party cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence across WBD brands.
* Contribute to **Audience Intelligence** capabilities, including ML Promo Optimizer, STAT v2, lookalike modeling inside Snowflake DCR, and content segmentation.
* Develop and productionize **forecasting** models for use cases such as audience growth, demand, yield, and pricing, ensuring models are monitored and continuously improved.
* Bring ML personalization signals, such as genre/content affinity and engagement trends, into batch and future real\-time activation paths.
* Implement MLOps workflows for experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, retraining, monitoring, and drift detection.

**Experimentation, Quality \& Observability**

* Implement offline and online evaluation approaches with clear baselines, success metrics, experiment design, and promotion criteria.
* Improve feature and label quality, leakage prevention, bias checks, calibration, explainability where applicable, and impact measurement.
* Identify technical risks early, document tradeoffs, and partner with engineering, data, product, and business stakeholders on mitigation plans.
* Turn incidents and postmortems into reusable learnings, automated checks, and platform improvements.
* Apply production\-readiness practices such as testability, data quality checks, rollback paths, drift monitoring, and dashboards.

**Cross\-functional Partnership \& Mentorship**

* Partner with ML leads on execution planning, technical design, capability development, and delivery of production ML systems.
* Represent the Hyderabad team in technical discussions with ML, Data Engineering, Product, Ad Sales, and US\-based stakeholders.
* Create clear design docs, readiness reviews, runbooks, and postmortem notes that strengthen engineering culture.
* Support junior engineers through implementation guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 3–5 years of ML engineering experience, or 2\+ years with a Ph.D., with demonstrated ownership of production ML components and cross\-functional delivery.
* You are comfortable building components across the ML lifecycle, from problem definition and feature engineering through serving, monitoring, and iteration.
* You have worked on optimization problems like ranking, personalization, forecasting, or multi\-objective decisioning in environments with interacting metrics.
* You have hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, SageMaker, Python, and SQL.
* You have experience in promoting ML models to production for large user populations and applying engineering standards and operational best practices.
* You have strong proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost/LightGBM, and scikit\-learn, plus solid grounding in statistics and ML fundamentals.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions to engineering, science, product, and business audiences.

**Preferred**

* Streaming / Identity / Fraud / Ad\-tech ML: identity resolution, audience modeling, recommendation/ranking, content understanding.
* Experience with real\-time feature serving and low\-latency inference, and with mixture\-of\-experts or graph neural networks.
* Published research or conference presentations in relevant ML domains.

**Our Technology Stack**

* **Primary platform:** AWS, Databricks.
* **Warehouse:** Snowflake.
* **Activation:** Mosaic, FreeWheel, Google Ad Manager.
* **Languages:** Python (primary), SQL, Scala (as needed).

 **What We Offer:**

* A great place to work.
* Equal opportunity employer.
* Fast\-track growth opportunities.

**How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**


Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

**About Innovapptive**


Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an **AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform** for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real\-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity.


Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly\-Clark, Scott Miracle\-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations.


Our customers have achieved **$50M\+ EBITDA** savings at a single enterprise, **10× improvement in frontline productivity**, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs.


Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in **Frost \& Sullivan's** “Frost Radar 2025 \- Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by **Vista Equity Partners** and **Tiger Global Management**.


With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.

**The Role**


Innovapptive’s Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product\-facing AI agents purpose\-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer\-specific asset data and SOPs.


This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle: from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer\-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust.

**What You Own**

* AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation.
* End\-to\-end agent lifecycle: requirements through architecture, build, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring.
* RAG and knowledge infrastructure: document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding.
* LLM governance: model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive’s AWS VPC — no data to external LLM endpoints.
* Agent quality: evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines.
* Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard.
* Hiring, performance management, and coaching.

**You Must Have**

* 7\+ years in software engineering with 3\+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM\-powered products in enterprise production.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi\-step agentic workflows.
* Strong grasp of RAG architecture: document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re\-ranking, and similarity thresholds.
* Experience with managed inference infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent.
* Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context — not just prototypes or internal tools.
* Familiarity with AI observability: prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent).
* Data\-driven: model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team.
* Strong engineering standards: prompt discipline, eval\-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production\-grade reliability.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data.
* Industrial domain knowledge: EAM, ERP integrations (SAP, Maximo), maintenance workflows, or field operations.
* Multi\-agent orchestration patterns: tool calling, agent\-to\-agent delegation, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Vision models or multimodal AI: image\-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation.
* MLOps and LLMOps: model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines.
* Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads: token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies.
* MongoDB and change stream\-based event architectures.

We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About the role**

The Delivery Operations Coordinator supports Crunchyroll’s global content distribution workflows, ensuring on\-time, accurate delivery of video, audio, subtitles, artwork, and metadata to partners, licensors, and internal systems. This role provides cross\-timezone coverage between U.S. and India, working closely with Media Operations, Production Management, and third\-party vendors to monitor storefronts, validate material readiness, and coordinate outbound deliveries for both owned\-and\-operated (O\&O) and partner platforms.


* Coordinate and track outbound deliveries to partners such as Delta, GCD, and licensors, ensuring timely and accurate file submissions across multiple time zones.

* Perform material readiness checks ahead of publish or delivery deadlines to verify all required assets are approved, QC’d, and available.
* Provide overlapping coverage between U.S. and Hyderabad to ensure near\-continuous delivery oversight.
* Partner with global teams to hand off ongoing tasks and ensure end\-to\-end visibility for each delivery window.
* Support EST shift coverage to align with vendor and partner business hours.

* 2–4 years of experience in digital media operations, delivery coordination, or content servicing.

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Local Lab Delivery Specialists while managing performance objectives, development plans, workload allocation, resource planning, and operational priorities.

  

**This role requires:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Health, Data Management, Mathematics, Computing, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of Clinical Data Management experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, or healthcare environments.
* 5\+ years of direct Local Laboratory Delivery experience and 2\+ years of people management experience.
* Advanced knowledge of local laboratory reference range management, including analyte interpretation, unit conversions, conversion algorithms, test synonym mapping, reference range evaluation, and metadata management.
* Strong understanding of local laboratory data collection, validation, maintenance, quality control, and delivery processes supporting Clinical Data Management.
* Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, Clinical Data Management principles, EDC systems, laboratory administration systems, and related clinical data technologies.
* Experience managing complex laboratory data issues through root cause analysis, CAPA development, issue resolution, and process remediation.
* Knowledge of applicable regulations, GxP requirements, clinical data quality principles, SOPs, and inspection\-readiness expectations.
* Demonstrated experience with operational metrics, targets, turnaround times, quality indicators, process improvement, and operational excellence.
