title: NOC Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
==================


Cubic Transportation Systems**Company Details:**
====================


When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  

  

We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.**Job Details:**
================


CTS is seeking a hands\-on Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager to build and operate a centralized, global 24x7 NOC based in Hyderabad, India. This role reports to the VP of Operations and is accountable for establishing the people, processes, and performance required to support more than 50 global customer programs delivering transit fare collection and payment card processing services.


The NOC Manager will lead a team of approximately 40–60 Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC analysts operating around the clock, with defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional field services teams. The role requires prior experience building or significantly maturing a 24x7 operations center and enforcing disciplined, repeatable operational practices aligned with ITIL 4, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS v4 operational monitoring expectations.

**Responsibilities**
====================


This is a build\-and\-operate leadership role responsible for end\-to\-end NOC effectiveness, including:

* Build and lead a centralized Hyderabad\-based NOC organization (40–60 staff) with Tier 1 and Tier 2 roles and defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional operations.
* Design and manage 24x7 shift coverage, staffing models, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish and operate 24x7 monitoring and event management for networks, systems, cloud services, applications, and OT/edge devices supporting transit payments.
* Implement and enforce ITIL\-aligned Incident Management, including triage, severity assignment, escalation, major incident coordination, communications, and post\-incident review.
* Ensure continuous verification of operational controls including log management, monitoring coverage, backup success, recovery testing, change control discipline, and DR readiness.
* Ensure NOC operations support PCI DSS v4 monitoring requirements and are executed in a manner consistent with ISO 27001 operational control and evidence expectations.
* Lead operational response to emergent incidents, ensuring rapid containment, service restoration, and accurate executive and stakeholder communications.
* Define and maintain runbooks, SOPs, escalation matrices, and shift handover standards.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences; drive continual improvement through trend analysis and postmortems.
* Coordinate closely with Security Operations (SOC) for escalation of operational anomalies with potential security implications.

**Essential Job Duties**
========================

* Operate a 24x7 NOC covering monitoring, performance and capacity management, incident management, logging, change coordination, backup verification, and DR readiness.
* Ensure rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of outages and degradations affecting customer\-facing payment and transit services.
* Lead major incident bridges and enforce structured communication and restoration validation.
* Ensure logging, monitoring, and telemetry failures are treated as operational risks and remediated with urgency.
* Produce and maintain incident records, reports, and operational evidence suitable for audit and compliance review.

**General Duties and Responsibilities**
=======================================

* Operate effectively under limited supervision in a high\-availability, mission\-critical environment.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and consistency in process execution and documentation.
* Communicate effectively in English, including written incident updates and executive\-level operational summaries.
* Motivate and lead teams across multiple shifts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Escalate issues appropriately while maintaining productive working relationships.
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to motivate activity to meet the needs, and adept at escalating in an effective manner that preserves relations.
* Able to reliably demonstrate ethical behavior and accurate communications even when complex factors are involved.
* Able to operate in a professional manner, even in crisis settings.
* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures

**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
===================================

**Essential**
-------------

* Proven experience building and leading a 24x7 NOC or equivalent mission\-critical operations organization.
* Strong command of monitoring \& event management and incident management, including major incident leadership.
* Experience operating hybrid environments including customer\-site data centers and Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated operational ownership of log management, backup verification, change/configuration control, and DR readiness.
* Experience working in regulated environments with strong audit and evidence requirements (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC, etc.).
* Establishes operational objectives, policies, procedures and work plans and delegates assignments to subordinates. Develops, modifies and executes company policies that affect immediate operations and may also have company\-wide effect. Accountable for department budget which may be broad and have far reaching impact on the business segment.
* Works on issues where analysis of situations or data requires conceptual thinking and an in\-depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Problems are not clearly defined and may lack strategic direction. Implements policies and selects methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Drives the strategy and success of larger projects which contribute to multiple areas of the organization.
* Interacts regularly with lower and/or senior management on matters concerning multiple functional areas, department, and/or customers. Requires the ability to persuade others in sensitive complex situations while preserving relationships. Applies knowledge to convince other stakeholders on desired departmental outcomes.
* This position must be able to create networks involving coordination among groups and provide thought leadership to pursue organization projects. This will require understanding of wider business and conveying advanced information and persuading several diverse stakeholders or audiences. The position must be recognized internally as a subject matter expert and will direct the activities of others.
* Demonstrated competency in strategic thinking and leadership with strong abilities in relationship management

**Desirable**
-------------

* Experienced in operations supporting payments or high\-volume transaction processing operations experience.
* Experience monitoring Operational Technology (OT) or distributed edge device ecosystems.
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent operational practice experience.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Essential**
-------------

* 12\-15\+ years of experience in mission\-critical IT or service operations, including people leadership in a 24x7 model.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Formal ITIL, ISO 27001, or operations management certifications.

description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-255176 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 17, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
**Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.


Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Channel Operations Leadership*

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.

*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*

* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.

*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*

* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.

*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*

* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.

*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*

* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.

*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*

* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.

*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*

* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.

**What We Expect of You**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive\-ready communication, people leadership, analytical, and change\-management skills.

You will work across a highly distributed environment supporting multi\-brand, multi\-country, and franchise operations with complex regulatory and operational requirements.


Your day will involve working closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to translate business needs into **scalable, resilient, and secure system designs**. You will lead architecture discussions, review designs and code, define API contracts, and ensure alignment across multiple engineering teams.


You will play a key role in modernizing legacy systems into **cloud\-native, microservices\-based, and event\-driven architectures**, ensuring high availability, performance, and extensibility. You will also guide teams on adopting best practices around **observability, fault tolerance, and CI/CD pipelines**.


A significant portion of your time will be spent mentoring engineers, influencing technical decisions, and ensuring consistency across platform architecture, while balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term strategic goals.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Define and own **end\-to\-end architecture** across Rental (RAC) and Digital platforms, including backend services, APIs, and frontend integrations
* Design and implement **cloud\-native architectures** using microservices, serverless patterns, and distributed systems
* Establish and govern **API\-first design principles** and integration patterns across systems (REST, GraphQL, event streaming)
* Drive adoption of **event\-driven architecture** (Kafka or equivalent) to enable scalable, loosely coupled systems
* Lead architecture for key platform capabilities including:


o Reservations and booking orchestration


o Pricing and rules engines


o Fleet and availability systems


o Customer profiles and identity


o Mobile and web experiences

* Ensure systems are designed for **high availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization**
* Define standards for **security, compliance, and data governance** across platforms
* Collaborate with engineering teams through design reviews, code reviews, and hands\-on technical guidance
* Guide adoption of **DevOps practices**, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability tools
* Evaluate and recommend new technologies, frameworks, and tools aligned with platform strategy
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture to align with broader technology strategy and shared services
* Leverage and promote **AI\-enabled development, automation, and intelligent system design practices**

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 10–15\+ years of experience in software engineering and architecture
* Proven experience designing and implementing **large\-scale, distributed systems**

o Java, Spring Boot, and backend architectures

title: Supervisor - Document Intelligence
description:
**ABOUT THIS ROLE**



GHX is standing up a new Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HiTL) operations team in Hyderabad to support its ADM (Automated Document Management) platform — an AI\-powered document processing system replacing legacy UiPath automation for GFax North America. The platform processes over 2\.2 million Purchase Orders per year and targets a 75–85% fully\-automated (touchless) rate. The team handles every document the AI cannot process autonomously.



The Operations Supervisor is building this team from zero and is accountable for everything within it: throughput, field accuracy, team development, day\-to\-day operations management, and real\-time coordination with GHX Engineering and Product teams in the United States. This is a high\-visibility, inaugural role — the team's accuracy and throughput directly determine the speed and confidence with which GHX can expand the ADM platform beyond GFax North America.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**People** **\& Performance Management — 70%**


* Directly supervise 15\-20 Document Review Specialists; own rostering across rotational shifts, attendance tracking, and queue capacity planning against daily document volume
* Manage operations SLA – TAT, Quality, along with people metrics
* Own day\-to\-day operations management: shift rosters and week\-offs, leave planning, planned \& unplanned shrinkage, absenteeism control, and real\-time reallocation of staffing to protect SLAs \& operations performance metrics
* Set and communicate daily, weekly, and monthly throughput, AHT, and accuracy targets; monitor individual and team performance against SLA and productivity standards
* Participate in and present at weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (WBR / MBR / QBR) — performance against KPIs, root\-cause analysis of misses, and committed corrective actions
* Own the full performance cycle for direct reports, including goal setting, mid\-year and annual appraisals, with documented performance ratings, development plans, and calibration against peer supervisors
* Conduct weekly 1:1s and team calibration sessions; coach on accuracy, field interpretation, and escalation judgment
* Manage performance improvement plans for specialists not meeting accuracy, AHT, or throughput standards; drive engagement and retention to control attrition
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members; maintain a bench and cross\-skilling plan to cover leave and attrition
* Proactively escalate capacity gaps and SLA risk to GHX US management before they impact queue throughput


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement— 20%**


* Identify patterns in AI extraction errors that indicate model weaknesses (e.g., systematic misread of specific templates); surface findings as structured product feedback to GHX Engineering
* Develop and maintain team SOPs, job aids, audit checklists, and the GHX field\-standards reference guide
* Recommend tool and process improvements to reduce per\-document review time (AHT) and improving accuracy
* Contribute to the ADM continuous improvement cycle by translating on\-the\-ground operational insight into prioritized product feedback
* Own team field accuracy at or above 99% for mandatory (Tier 1\) fields; track and report accuracy, throughput, and SLA attainment in a weekly dashboard
* Conduct periodical audits of each team member's work on a defined cadence (daily sampling, weekly per\-specialist audit, and monthly deep\-dive) with documented findings, scores, and feedback logged per specialist
* Conduct structured quality audits — sampled review of completed documents across team members — to detect systematic errors and training gaps
* Run audit\-driven coaching loops: convert audit findings into individual feedback, refresher training, and re\-audit to confirm the correction held
* Maintain and execute the escalation protocol for documents that cannot be resolved by specialists (damaged images, ambiguous formatting, novel document types)
* Own the error log: categorize error types, track frequency and trend, deliver structured feedback to GHX Engineering as actionable product input


**Cross\-Functional Coordination — 10%**


* Serve as the primary GHXI point of contact for GHX US Product and Engineering on Document Queue status, error patterns, and team capacity
* Participate in ADM platform update reviews; translate tool changes into updated team procedures and retraining plans before each release
* Deliver clear, data\-backed written status updates to US stakeholders; communicate GHX US expectations and standards to the Hyderabad team
* Coordinate with GHXI local management on workspace, IT, HR, compliance, rostering, transport, and facilities matters


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS OWNED BY THIS ROLE**



The Supervisor is accountable for the standard operational KPI set of a production contact\-center / transaction\-processing environment, reported in the weekly dashboard and reviewed in WBR, and MBR, forums:


* Productivity \& throughput: documents processed per specialist per hour, daily/weekly volume completed
* AHT (Average Handling Time) and average review time per document type
* SLA / TAT attainment: % of documents completed within committed turnaround; queue aging and backlog carried over
* Service level and queue wait for real\-time\-facing work; abandonment rate where applicable
* Quality: field\-level accuracy (Tier 1 99%), audit score per specialist, critical vs. non\-critical error rate, rework %, first\-pass yield, FCR (First Contact / First Pass Resolution)
* Occupancy and utilization; schedule adherence and conformance
* Shrinkage — planned (leave, training, meetings, breaks) and unplanned (unscheduled absence, late logins, system downtime)
* Absenteeism — planned and unplanned — and attrition (voluntary, involuntary, and early\-life attrition)
* Forecast vs. actual volume accuracy and staffing variance (required vs. rostered vs. actual)
* Escalation rate, reopen rate, and aging of escalated or exception items
* Customer\-impacting measures: CSAT / internal stakeholder satisfaction, NPS where measured, and downstream EDI failure or defect leakage rate
* Cost per transaction and productivity per FTE against the operating plan
* Training and certification: nesting graduation rate, time\-to\-proficiency for new hires, cross\-skilling coverage %


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate qualification in Operations, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* Minimum 6 years of total experience in BPO, KPO, shared services in a document processing operations
* Minimum 2 years in a confirmed Supervisory or Team lead role with accountability for 10 or more staff
* Demonstrated understanding \& ownership of core operational KPIs — SLA, AHT, quality/accuracy, shrinkage, absenteeism, and attrition — in a production environment
* Experience running periodical quality audits and sample\-based audit methodologies, with documented feedback and coaching loops
* Experience in owning the people\-management cycle: rostering, leave and shrinkage planning, mid\-year and annual appraisals, and performance improvement plans
* Experience in preparing for and presenting in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews
* Strong business English — written and verbal — for regular written and video communication with stakeholders
* Comfortable building and presenting weekly operational reports (throughput, AHT, accuracy trend, error categories) in Excel or Google Sheets
* Demonstrated ability to write clear SOPs, job aids, and team process guides from scratch
* Willing and able to work rotational shifts, including US Mountain Time night rotations, on\-site 5 days per week


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Prior exposure to AI\-augmented operations: annotation platforms, RLHF review queues, AI quality assurance, or document intelligence tools
* Experience coordinating with US\-based counterparts across time zones on a regular basis
* Background in procurement or supply chain document processing (Purchase Orders, invoices, order acknowledgements)
* Understanding of how AI confidence scoring works and the relationship between human corrections and model retraining
* Workforce management exposure — forecasting, capacity planning, and roster optimisation experience
* Six Sigma, Lean, or equivalent process improvement certification
* Greenfield experience — prior role that required standing up a new team or operations function with minimal existing infrastructure


**WORKING CONDITIONS**


**Location:** GHX India (GHXI) office, Hyderabad, Telangana — on\-site, 5 days per week; ***no remote or hybrid option***


**Shift:** Rotational shifts on a 24x7 roster, including night rotations aligned to US Mountain Time (\~8:30 PM–4:30 AM IST (MDT) / \~9:30 PM–5:30 AM IST (MST)); week\-offs rotate with the roster


**US Coordination:** Regular video calls with GHX US Engineering, Product, and Director, Automation \& Scalability (functional line)

title: M365 End User Computing Architect
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------


The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.


The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands\-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end architectural vision and roadmap for the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and the broader M365 suite
* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low\-code/no\-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long\-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365\), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance \& Standards**
---------------------------

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation
* Establish M365 governance frameworks including tenant policies, external sharing controls, Teams provisioning governance, and data residency requirements
* Define and socialize naming conventions, RBAC models, licensing optimization strategies, and change management processes
* Conduct architecture reviews for EUC\-impacting projects and provide design authority sign\-off

**Security \& Compliance**
--------------------------

* Partner with the Information Security team to integrate Zero Trust principles throughout the EUC environment
* Architect solutions leveraging Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and the broader Microsoft Defender XDR suite
* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365\.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across the core Microsoft 365 workloads:


	+ **Collaboration \& Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
	+ **Identity \& Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
	+ **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
	+ **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
	+ **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
	+ **Automation \& Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud\-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future\-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross\-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross\-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
	+ Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI\-readiness assessments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and their application in enterprise EUC environments
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.)
* Background in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)

description:
Job Description
  
  

**Specialist:** Data Engineering
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology\-driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are hiring ahands\-on Data Engineer who can design, build, and operate production\-grade data platforms and pipelines end to end. You will deliver reliable, governed, secure, and analytics\-ready data by implementing moderndata warehousing andLakehouse patterns onAWS andDatabricks, with strong focus ondata quality,dimensional modeling, and scalableETL/ELT. This role partners closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust datasets, while applying engineering best practices such as testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and observability.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
  

* Design, build, and operatebatch and streaming data pipelines to ingest data from multiple sources into anAWS data lake / lakehouse anddata warehouse.
* Develop and maintainETL/ELT transformations usingPython,PySpark, and SQL; optimize jobs for performance, cost, and reliability.
* Partner with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to understand use cases and delivercurated, analytics\-ready datasets and features.
* Implementdata quality controls (validation rules, reconciliation, anomaly checks), defineSLAs/SLOs, and contribute tometadata, lineage, anddata catalog practices.
* Use orchestration and observability to run pipelines reliably (e.g.,Databricks Workflows,AWS Step Functions, scheduling, logging, monitoring, alerting).
* Apply engineering best practices: unit/integration testing, automateddata tests, code reviews, and quality gates withinCI/CD.
* Model and publish data for BI/analytics usingdimensional modeling (star/snowflake), facts dimensions, andslowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Write and tuneadvanced SQL for profiling, transformations, and performance troubleshooting across large datasets.
* Build onAWS using services such asS3,Glue,Lambda,Step Functions,EMR, and CloudWatch; follow security best practices (IAM, encryption, least privilege).
* Provision and manage cloud resources usingInfrastructure as Code (e.g.,Terraform) across dev/test/prod environments.
* Package and deploy workloads usingDocker (and where applicable ECS/Fargate); manage dependencies and runtime configurations.
* UseGitHub for version control (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and set upCI/CD for automated build, test, and deployment.
* Develop scalable processing onDatabricks /Apache Spark usingPySpark and lakehouse concepts (e.g.,Delta Lake, ACID, schema evolution).
* Use notebooks (e.g., Jupyter/Databricks) for exploration and PoCs, then productionize solutions with reusable modules, tests, and deployment pipelines.
* Work in anAgile delivery model (planning, daily sync, reviews, retros), providing accurate estimates and proactively managing risks/dependencies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation (data contracts, pipeline specs, runbooks) and support operational handoffs.


**What Should you have:**  

* 5 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering building production pipelines and data5 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering building production pipelines and data platforms.
* StrongAWS experience: S3,Glue,Lambda,Step Functions,EMR (and/or ECS/Fargate), plus CloudWatch; solid grasp of IAM and encryption.
* Nice to have: AWS certification (Developer/Architect) or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Experience working inAgile teams; strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience withDatabricks and lakehouse capabilities (e.g., Delta Lake, job/workflow orchestration, cluster tuning) is strongly preferred.
* StrongSQL skills including complex joins/window functions, data profiling, and performance tuning; understanding ofdimensional modeling concepts.
* Proficient inPython andPySpark with solid Spark fundamentals (partitioning, shuffle, caching, file formats) and ability to debug/optimize.
* Strong withGitHub,CI/CD concepts, and engineering practices (code reviews, branching, release management); working knowledge ofDocker andTerraform.
* Demonstrated ability to work across teams, drive alignment, and take ownership to deliver outcomes (including production support/on call as needed).
* Nice to have experience in ETL tools such as DBT, Matillion and data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Collibra) and data governance tools such as Immuta
* Nice to have experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), streaming (Kafka/Kinesis), and modern table formats (Delta/Iceberg/Hudi).
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**Primary Skills:**  

Python, PySpark, SQL, AWS, Databricks, GitHub, Data Lake, ETL/ELT and CI/CD
  
  

**Secondary Skills:**  

Dimensional modeling, Docker and Terraform

We are known as well\-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. What we look for
  
  

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment & Service India
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.



You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.



The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia\-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia \& New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow\-the\-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.



As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.



To be successful in this team, you will also have:


* Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
* Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed


Controls Deployment \& Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.



Key job responsibilities Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand\-Off (PFHO)


* Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
* Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
* Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures


A day in the life


* Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom\-designed processors and chips.
* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission\-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry\-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.


About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. ### **Basic Qualifications**


* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development
* 7\+ years of operations management experience
* Experience leading process improvements
* 5\+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
* Experience in major facilities incident management

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 3\+ months of network and operating system support experience
* Experience in project management
* 1\+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large\-scale operations
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or equivalent
